entries.text: Experimental gizmosql platform: runs TPC-H and TPC-DS on a GizmoSQL Core 1.37+ server (DuckDB backend) through the official adbc-driver-gizmosql driver (install with the gizmosql extra). Tables load client-side as byte-bounded Arrow batches, one transaction per table, into a schema named for the benchmark, scale factor and tuning configuration. A populated table is reused only when its row count matches the source files; otherwise the load fails without deleting anything. TLS is verified by default, credentials are redacted, server-wide settings are never changed, read-only servers support query-only runs, and each throughput stream has its own session.
